_purpose: Co-owned action; an owner that is a team rather than a person; an unassigned action discussed by three speakers; latency and timing figures that must survive.

discussion_points.polished_text: Sanjay and Priya will jointly draft the ARINC 429 interface control document and deliver it by 15 May.
discussion_points.speaker: Sanjay

action_items.task: Draft the ARINC 429 interface control document

discussion_points.polished_text: Priya reported that measured ARINC 429 bus latency is 12 ms against a budget of 20 ms, which is within limits.
discussion_points.speaker: Priya

discussion_points.polished_text: Rahul raised that the mission computer boot time of 45 s exceeds the 30 s requirement. It was decided that the firmware team will investigate the boot sequence.
discussion_points.speaker: Rahul

action_items.task: Investigate the mission computer boot sequence to meet the 30 s requirement

discussion_points.polished_text: Sanjay reminded everyone that visitor parking will be closed on Thursday.
discussion_points.speaker: Sanjay

discussion_points.polished_text: Rahul, Priya and Sanjay discussed that the wiring diagrams are out of date and should be updated, but no one took ownership.
discussion_points.speaker: Rahul
